scope: Every simulator type except the 737-800 (see phase-1.json). One primary and one fallback per type. Sketchfab rows need Brook's logged-in download into raw/models/<id>/. FlightGear rows are public SVN/git and can be fetched by script once approved; they are GPL and need decision D16. The hangar's H145 stays procedural (it is a case-study feature and not a simulator type).

sources.sketchfab: https://sketchfab.com — CC BY 4.0 unless noted; provenance judged from description, upload history and re-upload detection (identical face counts under two accounts = reject)
sources.flightgear-fgaddon: https://sourceforge.net/p/flightgear/fgaddon/HEAD/tree/trunk/Aircraft/ — GPL-2.0-or-later; .ac (AC3D) geometry + PNG textures; per-aircraft authors in each README/AUTHORS
sources.flightgear-github: current development repos for c172p (c172p-team), A320-family (legoboyvdlp), f16 (NikolaiVChr) — GPL-2.0; the FGMEMBERS org is a 2016–2019 mirror, used only where no current repo exists
sources.rejected-sources: TurboSquid/CGTrader/Free3D 'royalty-free' terms forbid redistributing the files (a glTF on a CDN is redistribution); NASA 3D Resources has no airliners or fighters; Blend Swap needs Blender, which is not installed; DCS/War Thunder/MSFS rips on Sketchfab are excluded by description and re-upload checks

rows.author: legoboyvdlp, Octal450, merspieler and the A320-family contributors (AUTHORS in repo)
rows.title: FlightGear A320-family (A321 variant)
rows.bytes: repo 726 MB incl. history; Models/ ≈ 60 MB, fetched sparse
rows.evidence: the flagship Airbus of the open-source sim, actively maintained; the family package carries A318/A319/A320/A321 fuselage variants
rows.concerns: GPL (D16); .ac conversion is our script; the cockpit's displays are FlightGear canvas and are replaced by ours
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY for A321 exterior and the sidestick-glass cockpit

rows.author: Otto Kirchhoff
rows.title: A321ceo_sharklets
rows.evidence: 48 materials, MSN/hours in the description read like an engineer's own model
rows.concerns: untextured; 24 downloads; Wizz Air reference implies a livery in materials
rows.recommendation: FALLBACK if D16 is refused

rows.author: as a321-exterior
rows.title: FlightGear A320-family (A320-200 variant)
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY (same package; one download serves both)

rows.author: TonyWony
rows.title: A320-200 with cockpit (ver VIII)
rows.evidence: versioned uploads by one author; 5,179 downloads, 151 likes; includes a cockpit
rows.concerns: 'created for XS flight simulator' (the author's own project, by the versioning); 80 MB raw, needs KTX2
rows.recommendation: FALLBACK

rows.author: LDawesome
rows.title: Boeing 747-400 airplane
rows.evidence: 'noai' tag (an artist guarding original work), 5 materials, blank finish
rows.concerns: 127 downloads; 2 textures for a 747 means most detail is geometry
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY exterior

rows.author: FlightGear 747-400 authors (README in package)
rows.title: FlightGear 747-400
rows.concerns: 2000s-era textures; cockpit geometry fine, textures re-authored
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY cockpit geometry (yoke-glass family), else §7 builder

rows.author: mudkipz321
rows.title: Boeing 787-9 Singapore Airlines
rows.evidence: 'Designed in blender, created for a friend'; 6,057 downloads, 158 likes; re-uploaded by three other accounts (which confirms this is the original)
rows.concerns: Singapore Airlines livery: the livery texture is replaced, not shipped
rows.modified: repainted to AXZ, rigged, Draco, KTX2
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY (FlightGear's 787-9 has unclear authorship — 'model by Maxim, whoever that is' — and is rejected)

rows.author: the c172p team (AUTHORS in repo)
rows.title: FlightGear Cessna 172P
rows.format: .ac + PNG (interior.png 4.0 MB, panel.png 3.1 MB, fuselage.png 1.6 MB)
rows.evidence: the most detailed free GA aircraft that exists: every switch modelled, textured interior, active team
rows.concerns: GPL (D16); 172P not 172S (the roster says 172S; cosmetic differences)
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY exterior and analogue cockpit

rows.author: NLM
rows.title: FREE Cessna 172SP
rows.evidence: 'Blender 3.2, Substance Painter 2K, game-ready, detailed interior with cockpit'; 1,400 downloads, 77 likes; a studio account
rows.concerns: 24 MB raw
rows.recommendation: FALLBACK if D16 is refused; near-equal quality

rows.author: FlightGear Concorde authors (ReadmeModel.txt)
rows.title: FlightGear Concorde
rows.evidence: full flight deck including the flight-engineer panel; droop nose and visor animated in the source XML
rows.concerns: GPL (D16); textures are 2015-era and get re-authored
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY (no credible CC BY Concorde: the two 208k-face 4K ones are the same model under two accounts with BA marks)

rows.author: manilov.ap
rows.title: Concorde
rows.concerns: low poly; airline marks in textures; the fleet's uniform game-grade style suggests an unstated origin
rows.recommendation: FALLBACK

rows.author: Luca Martina
rows.title: Gulfstream G650ER
rows.evidence: 1,039 downloads, 26 likes; the only real G650 on any free source
rows.concerns: untextured (authored skin); provenance unstated
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY; cockpit authored (yoke-glass family)

rows.author: Nikolai V. Chr. and the f16 contributors (AUTHORS in repo)
rows.title: FlightGear F-16
rows.evidence: the best free F-16 anywhere: blend source in repo, full cockpit, active author
rows.concerns: GPL (D16); DDS textures need conversion
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY exterior and fighter cockpit

rows.author: andertan
rows.title: Lockheed Martin F-16E/F "Fighting Falcon"
rows.evidence: one author's consistent F-16/F-22/F-35 set; 2,570 downloads, 189 likes
rows.concerns: Block 60 (UAE) variant vs the roster's F-16C
rows.recommendation: FALLBACK

rows.author: NLM
rows.title: F22 Raptor FREE
rows.evidence: 'animated, textured, game-ready'; 2,474 downloads, 178 likes; same studio as the C172SP
rows.concerns: 61 MB raw (89 textures) → KTX2 and atlas to ≈ 8 MB
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY; cockpit authored (fighter family) — FlightGear's F-22 is a 2019 FGUK mirror with 200 KB textures

rows.author: andertan
rows.title: Lockheed Martin F-22 "Raptor"
rows.concerns: 11k faces is low for a close cockpit-cam view of the airframe
rows.recommendation: FALLBACK

rows.author: andertan
rows.title: Lockheed Martin F35 Lightning II
rows.concerns: none beyond unstated provenance
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY exterior

rows.author: FlightGear F-35B authors
rows.title: FlightGear F-35B (Cockpit.ac)
rows.concerns: GPL-3 (D16); B variant cockpit for an A
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY cockpit geometry, else the fighter builder

rows.author: Immersive3D
rows.title: [PBR] B-2 Spirit
rows.evidence: a studio account; PBR set (albedo/normal/roughness/metal); 85 likes
rows.concerns: 69 MB raw → KTX2 ≈ 6 MB; FlightGear's B-2 has no licence file and 1990s .rgb textures, rejected
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY; cockpit authored (fighter family, B-2 uses a yoke: yoke-glass layout in a two-seat deck)

rows.author: bohmerang
rows.title: Boeing B-52 Stratofortress
rows.evidence: a known author of free military aircraft (his fighters are NC-SA, this one is BY); 4,414 downloads, 259 likes; re-uploaded by thomas333 (which confirms the original)
rows.concerns: 1024 textures; 16.6k faces
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY; FlightGear B-52F (1990s .rgb textures) rejected; cockpit authored

rows.author: FlightGear 737-800 authors (README in package)
rows.title: FlightGear 737-800 (cockpit.ac, flightdesk.ac, pedestal.ac, oh-panel.ac, pedals.ac)
rows.evidence: a complete modelled 737 flight deck: glareshield, MCP, pedestal, overhead, pedals
rows.concerns: GPL (D16); displays are FlightGear canvases, replaced by ours; 2010s textures re-authored
rows.recommendation: PRIMARY cockpit for the three 737 regs (Phase 2), replacing the authored builder in D14 for this type

decisions: D16 GPL-2.0-or-later / GPL-3.0-or-later for FlightGear rows (recommended YES: unlocks textured cockpits for 737, A320/A321, C172, F-16, Concorde, F-35 and the best free C172 and F-16)
D17 mixed licences per aircraft, one row per part (no objection expected)
which of the two Cessnas: FlightGear c172p (GPL, most detailed) or NLM-Group 172SP (CC BY, near-equal, matches the roster's 172S)
the fetch order after approval: 737-800 (Phase 1) → Concorde → 747-400 → F-22 → A321 (spec D7), the rest in Phase 4
